coordinate_system: top-left origin; +x right; +y down; all corner values in source-image pixels

logical_grid.orientation: friendly left / enemy right; y=0 far, y=7 near

surface.bounds_semantics: map logical outer corners (0,0),(12,0),(12,7),(0,7); exclude decorative rim, sidewall, lanterns, stairs and all external ground

projection_proposal.warning: not bilinear linear-row interpolation; not production camera calibration

display_proposal.outside_fill_note: same dark-forest tone behind HUD; no second enlarged copy of the platform

actor_scale_proposal.interpolation: same continuous projective depth factor as surface; interpolate current moving ground point, not discrete destination row
actor_scale_proposal.notes: preserve existing animation identity/proportions; keep HUD text readable rather than compress fonts with depth

runtime_requirements: one shared forward/inverse projection for surface/grid/selection/range/input
reuse animated units; no baked demonstration characters
avoid double-drawing existing platform, lamps and stairs
feet/contact and cast shadows/sorting/bars/projectile source points align
